title: A new sequence under a key, in a document with no nested mapping and no sequence, is indented two spaces
notes: The document is one flat mapping: there is no sibling sequence to copy and no nested block mapping to take an indentation step from. The patch adds `/n` with the sequence `[1]`. The specification allows any indentation of the dash greater than the key's, and the dash flush with the key, so the bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md): with no step to take, the dash is indented two spaces, written `  - 1`. The case carries the tag `convention`. The new member goes at the end of the root mapping, which is a second convention (RFC 6902 does not fix the position). The result reads back as `a` is 1 and `n` is a sequence of the single item 1; no nested mapping is created.
